description: This is a JUnit test class for the ObjectMapperFactory, testing its singleton behavior, JSON serialization/deserialization of Java 8 date/time types, null handling, and ignoring unknown properties.

classes.name: ObjectMapperFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ObjectMapperFactory, validating singleton behavior, date/time serialization, null handling, and ignoring unknown properties.

methods.name: testSharedObjectMapperNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that the shared ObjectMapper instance is not null.

methods.name: testSharedObjectMapperSingleton
methods.description: Ensures that multiple calls to getShared() return the same ObjectMapper instance (singleton).

methods.name: testJava8DateTimeSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization of LocalDate using the ObjectMapper.

methods.name: testJava8DateTimeDeserialization
methods.description: Tests deserialization of JSON with a LocalDate field into a TestObject.

methods.name: testNullHandling
methods.description: Verifies serialization when the date field is null.

methods.name: testDeserializeNullValue
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of JSON with null date property.

methods.name: testUnknownPropertiesIgnored
methods.description: Verifies that unknown JSON properties are ignored during deserialization.

methods.name: testCreateObjectMapperNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that creating a new ObjectMapper returns a non-null instance.
